reviews.comment: Keeps my cpu cool and looks and works better than just a cooling fan!

reviews.title: Quality RBG AIO
reviews.comment: The MAG Core Liquid A15 is a high quality AIO Liquid Cooler. MSI delivers premium quality at affordable prices that are only beat by off brand or 3rd party manufacturers. The RGB looks fantastic and the installation is as simple as an AIO liquid cooler can be, albeit I was using an MSI case. Highly recommend this if pairing with any MSI motherboard, specifically the B850 series. Keeps my CPU sub 50 consistently.
reviews.author: TroyS
